data.action: 按住耳侧通讯发饰遥望风沙
data.description: 【佩丽卡 · 塔罗斯荒原】狂风席卷着黄色沙尘的塔罗斯II异星荒原断崖边缘，佩丽卡按住被强风吹乱的浅色短发，目光坚定地注视着远处拔地而起的巨型工业基建枢纽——「这颗星球的环境虽然极其恶劣，但只要终末地的开拓者们还在前进，我们就一定能在这片荒原上建立起崭新的家园。」
data.promptProse: At the edge of a Talos II wasteland cliff, Perlica presses a hand against her windblown pale short hair and watches the huge infrastructure hub rising in the distance. Her khaki explorer coat and backpack face the amber dust in a medium-wide view. The cliff drops past the foreground toward industrial structures. Dust-filtered sunlight catches her sleeve and pack edge, softening the shadows over distant construction.
data.title: 佩丽卡 · 塔罗斯荒原
